mapper.select: SELECT a.time AS time,area AS area,a.total AS total,a.normal AS normal,a.abnormal AS abnormal,b.hostname AS name,b.ip AS ip FROM traffic_abnormal_machine AS b RIGHT JOIN (SELECT id,commit_time AS time,area,total,normal,abnormal FROM traffic_nmsserver_statistic WHERE commit_time = (SELECT commit_time AS time FROM traffic_nmsserver_statistic ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) ) a ON b.nmsServer_Id = a.id

SELECT ifnull(d.entrance_id,0) AS area,'INOCTETS' AS type,SUM(tt.incount) AS count,time FROM (SELECT IF((b.INOCTETS - a.INOCTETS ) >0 ,b.INOCTETS - a.INOCTETS ,b.INOCTETS) AS incount,b.ip2 AS ip,#{push} AS time FROM (SELECT SUM(INOCTETS) AS INOCTETS,NODE_IP AS ip1 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{before} AND RECV_TIME< #{start} GROUP BY ip1 ) a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT SUM(INOCTETS) AS INOCTETS,NODE_IP AS ip2 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{start} AND RECV_TIME< #{end} GROUP BY ip2) b ON a.ip1=b.ip2 ) tt LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id,manager_ip FROM ntc_device_info ) d ON d.manager_ip = tt.ip GROUP BY area UNION ALL SELECT ifnull(d.entrance_id,0) AS area,'OUTOCTETS' AS type,SUM(tt.outcount) AS count,time FROM (SELECT if((b.OUTOCTETS - a.OUTOCTETS ) >0 ,b.OUTOCTETS - a.OUTOCTETS ,b.OUTOCTETS) AS outcount,b.ip2 AS ip,#{push} AS time FROM (SELECT SUM(OUTOCTETS)AS OUTOCTETS,NODE_IP AS ip1 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{before} AND RECV_TIME< #{start} GROUP BY ip1) a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT SUM(OUTOCTETS) AS OUTOCTETS,NODE_IP AS ip2 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{start} AND RECV_TIME< #{end} GROUP BY ip2) b ON a.ip1=b.ip2 ) tt LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id,manager_ip FROM ntc_device_info GROUP BY entrance_id,manager_ip ) d ON d.manager_ip = tt.ip GROUP BY area
SELECT RECV_TIME FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME < #{end} ORDER BY RECV_TIME DESC LIMIT 1
